reason: The first thing I look for is how a tool tracks billable hours per client, and this doesn't mention time tracking at all. Client pages and a board are nice, but they don't help me bill, and I'm not dragging the team off Slack and Trello for that.
objection: No billable-hours tracking per client, so I'd still need a separate time tracker on top of it, and moving everyone off Slack and Trello is a lot of disruption for a tool that doesn't fix my billing.
would_change_my_mind: Built-in time tracking per client and per task that rolls up into billable-hours reports I can invoice from.
